dimension_description: Mass tracks inertia and the amount of matter under a stated definition, from subatomic particles to galaxies. Some entries are direct measurements, while others are derived estimates such as the mass of a lake from its volume and density. Every item names the object and the measurement basis so the scale remains comparable.
